## Features
- Warm and cool white LED icicle lights
- Durable black and whie rubber cable
- Connectable upto 50m Length

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 per cent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional-quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance, and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

- Snowfall LED Maypole Christmas tree with cascading micro LEDs
- Mixed white or multi-colour LEDs with 8-setting speed controller

## Information
Bring a magical festive glow to your home with this Christow Snowfall LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Available in 1.4m, 2.1m, and 2.5m sizes, it’s illuminated by cascading micro LEDs to create a spectacular snowfall light effect. A glowing LED star adds an enchanting finishing touch, while a choice of mixed white or multi-coloured LEDs allows you to create the perfect festive display. Snowfall Light Motion Beautifully illuminated by cascading micro LEDs, the tree creates a mesmerising snowfall light effect. A glowing LED star adds seasonal charm, while an 8-setting controller lets you adjust the speed or select a traditional static glow. Sleek Black Frame Designed with a black metal pole and base, the tree blends into the darkness at night to create a more attractive illuminated silhouette. The base is treated with electrophoresis rust prevention to improve durability outdoors. Indoor Plug with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug, the tree is suitable for plugging into indoor sockets only. With a 5m length, the cable gives you plenty of flexibility to position the tree outdoors while plugging it into an indoor socket. Easy to Assemble & Secure Simply slot the base and poles together, then secure the pre-attached string lights to the base for easy assembly. Supplied with six U-shaped ground stakes, it can also be anchored to soft ground for greater outdoor stability.
